answer: Beacon spot-checks plus heartbeats block bulk fakes. At the dawn of each epoch, a beacon picks 5% of agents, who must in an hour prove work with a heartbeat, checked in their harbor register. An honest agent pays one heartbeat and one bond, keeping rewards undiluted. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 heartbeats: 2 units plus a 50-unit bond each totals 5,200 units, and a missed check slashes the bond. A jade seal after three passes marks agents.
